identity: A close, sleeveless vest worn over a shirt, closed to a narrow gap down the front and ending at the waist. Each panel's shoulder and outer seam are the wearer's own shoulder-arc and side curves, same fitting as jacket, just closed up and cropped shorter.

regions.note: left front panel. 0 free hem, 1 fits torso.side_left reversed, 2 fits torso.shoulder_arc_left reversed (shoulder to collar), 3-4 free narrow front edge back down to the hem.
right front panel, mirror of the left.
